findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "행사안내 바로가기" above "스케줄"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 23 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): a 1328px | a 1328px | a 1328px | a 1328px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "행사안내 바로가기" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "조 편성이 확정되면 이 페이지에 업데이트됩니다." 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "PROMISED LAND" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "BEPPU · OITA" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 1041px of the width empty: "각층별안내".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 19 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "WORSHIP SESSION", "PROMISED LAND", "JOSHUA GENERATION", "BEPPU · OITA").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 57% of the width empty: "Worship" (right 437px empty); "각층별안내" (right 394px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 652px at 8448px (the screen is 1024px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.
